text:
emma: Quick sync — retention cutover for console observability dashboards/traces. Who's owning final signoff? We need a canary (48h?) before wide rollout. cc @raj @sofia @mike

raj: I can own dashboard signoff (viz + queries). Need infra confirmation we can change retention TTL without query regressions. @mike can you confirm?

mike: Infra side: we can change TTL, but must run migration for archived traces and validate index sizes. 48h canary sounds fine. I'll open a migration PR and attach runbook. PR: https://git.internal/r/migrations/obs-retention-343

sofia: For error-analysis views we should keep 7d of full traces and sample older spans. Otherwise alert histograms will break. Proposed config snippet for canary:```tracing:
  retention_days: 30
  sampling:
    default: 0.1
    error: 1.0```

emma: That config looks right to me. Two quick asks: (1) can the canary be limited to prod namespace `console-canary` so we don't affect other teams? (2) who will monitor error regression dashboards during canary?

mike: Yes — we can route canary to `console-canary` pool. I'll update terraform and sidecar configs, add gating job to abort if index growth > +20% in 6h.

observability-bot: scheduled_job: retention-canary-started for `console-canary` at 2026-03-06T09:30Z (job_id: sj-8721)

sofia: I'll monitor error regression queries and alert on signal-noise increase. Who has rights to adjust alert thresholds if we see false positives?

raj: I can adjust dashboard-level thresholds for the canary only. We'll keep global alerts untouched.

mike: Migration PR: https://git.internal/r/migrations/obs-retention-343 (WIP). I'll add CI tests that run a small synthetic workload to validate tail-query latency < 250ms.

emma: Ownership summary: dashboards -> raj, error views/regressions -> sofia, infra/migration + gating -> mike. Emma will own cross-team comms and update the roadmap ticket. Can we commit to starting canary end of day Thursday (48h window Fri-Sat)?

raj: Thursday EOD works for dashboards team.

sofia: Works for error-analysis. I'll schedule on-call rotations for weekend monitoring.

mike: I'll aim to have PR and terraform ready by Thursday morning.

deploy-bot: canary_deploy: `obs-retention-canary` started by mike at 2026-03-05T18:02Z

emma: Sweet. I'll update ticket OBSP-4723 with owners and canary dates, and post an announcement in #general before kick. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

sofia: One last note — please ensure we tag any sample-rate changes in the changelog so downstream jobs (replayers, evals) can reference them.

emma: Good call. Added to runbook checklist. Closing thread unless blockers pop up.
